Package org.apache.beam.sdk.transforms

Class Regex.MatchesNameKV

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.transforms.PTransform<PCollection<String>,PCollection<KV<String,String>>>
org.apache.beam.sdk.transforms.Regex.MatchesNameKV
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, HasDisplayData
Enclosing class:
Regex
public static class Regex.MatchesNameKV extends PTransform<PCollection<String>,PCollection<KV<String,String>>>
Regex.MatchesNameKV<KV<String, String>> takes a PCollection<String> and returns a PCollection<KV<String, String>> representing the key and value extracted from the Regex groups of the input PCollection to the number of times that element occurs in the input.

This transform runs a Regex on the entire input line. If the entire line does not match the Regex, the line will not be output. If it does match the entire line, the groups in the Regex will be used. The key will be the key's group and the value will be the value's group.

Example of use: 


 PCollection<String> words = ...;
 PCollection<KV<String, String>> keysAndValues =
     words.apply(Regex.matchesKV("myregex (?<keyname>mykeygroup) (?<valuename>myvaluegroup)",
       "keyname", "valuename"));
